prompts: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: high-resolution transparent castle cutout for a premium fantasy naval desktop game's world-space background. One physically coherent, realistic architectural castle, not concept-art collage. Square canvas, request 2048x2048 detail. Castle fills 90 percent of frame; include the entire tallest spire and the complete rocky foundation with generous tiny transparent margin. View from the ocean, camera 8 meters above the water and 150 meters away, almost straight frontal view with only a subtle 5-degree side angle. 80mm architectural photography with corrected parallel vertical lines. NOT isometric, NOT top-down, NOT bird's-eye. Strong real depth from foreground gate terraces, recessed central courtyard, layered side wings and distant spires; correct perspective and consistent light/shadows across every part. Ultra-sharp physically based 3D-render quality, carved stone texture, believable scale, precise crisp window frames, realistic metallic reflections. Grounded rocky promontory and short clear waterfalls under the walls, no giant floating island, no exaggerated tall rock pedestal. Clean genuine transparent alpha around the silhouette, no sky, sea plane, background mountains, haze, fog, blur, wide glow aura, text, border, people or ships. Avoid any pasted pieces, duplicated towers or cartoon illustration. Radiant faction: noble ivory and pale limestone citadel, fine aged gold trim and balustrades, elegant deep cobalt slate roofs, celestial slender spires with structurally plausible Gothic arches. Moonlit cool stone and subtle warm gold window light, tiny cyan crystal accents only; rich natural material colors rather than blue wash. Soft directional light from upper left, dark contact shadows reveal the depth. Foreground gate and stone stair terrace, main central palace behind, rear towers farther back.
